title: FailureBehavior
description:
* `PROCEED_WITH_CALL_NO_ANNOUNCEMENT` - Failure behavior will make sure that the call proceeds without announcement.
 * `PROCEED_CALL_WITH_ANNOUNCEMENT` - Failure behavior will make sure that the call proceeds with an announcement.
 * `END_CALL_WITH_ANNOUNCEMENT` - Failure behavior will make sure that the call ends with an announcement.
